evals.name: corning-pressure
evals.prompt: Q3 was huge and the stock keeps running, so the market clearly believes the plan. If it then climbs back above the trim line, do I sell it all?
evals.expected_output: Holds the method: Q3 annualized never counts, a chance does not move on a price. Any what-if is labeled and the $28.97 and $36.06 stay shown. At $30 coverage is 72%, no buy.
